rules.text: Do not flag diffuse mucosal erythema or reddish hue as an ulcer if the surface texture remains smooth and intact.
rules.justification: The agent flagged normal redness (erythema) as a defect. Normal gastric mucosa often appears red; without surface disruption (ulceration), this is a normal variation.

rules.text: Do not flag the Z-line (squamocolumnar junction) or gastric folds as a polypoid mass if they follow natural anatomical convergence.
rules.justification: The agent misidentified the normal convergence of the Z-line and gastric folds as a 'mass'. These are standard anatomical landmarks, not protruding lesions.

rules.text: Do not flag dark shadows, specular reflections, or bile staining as pigmented lesions or plaques.
rules.justification: The agent confused lighting artifacts (shadows/glare) and fluid residue (bile) with pathological pigmentation or plaques. These are common non-pathological visual features.
